dedupe_keys.name: self rescue zones of dam emergency action plans minas gerais ide sisema feam

description: A map layer of the self-rescue zones downstream of dams in Minas Gerais, Brazil, mostly mining and tailings dams. The IDE-Sisema metadata record says the layer shows the Zona de Autossalvamento from the extreme simulated breach scenario in each dam's hypothetical dam break study, part of its emergency action plan (PAE), with a status field showing whether the plan is approved or still under analysis. It holds 124 polygons in SIRGAS 2000 at a 1:5,000 equivalent scale, created in February 2025, revised January 2026 and updated bimonthly. The layer can be viewed and downloaded free of charge in the IDE-Sisema geoviewer, with a data dictionary, and a cross-referenced layer holds the flood footprints. Coverage is Minas Gerais. Caveats: the record lists the formats only through the geoviewer, and the licence is not stated on the page read beyond free access. For simulation it gives official breach flood zones to test exposure of roads, towns and water intakes to tailings dam failure. A related catalogue record is Brazil ANM SIGBM mining dams.
